conclusions: All three final four-sample comparisons preserve full actions/route/quality and work; 70/25/39 actions respectively. No TimeLimit samples.
Winning discard scene: mean search -3.4384%, allocation -8.6329%, process peak RSS -5.7839%; both B samples faster than both A samples; only two samples per variant.
Initial Silent starter+6 scene remains onlyDeathRoutes, final enemyHP357; search -5.5184%, allocation -4.6518%, peak RSS +0.1097%. Not victory evidence.

No-hit crab: 0 captures/reuses; mean allocation +0.0713%; baseline time drift -8.2997% is larger than observed mean time change -3.6232%; no attributable speedup claim. GC pause mean 6.424s ->13.110s (+104.08%) is adverse and its cause is not established.
Headless process peak includes setup and is not managed live heap or visible frame time. No visible Steam or Windows performance evidence.
Broader card/potion/relic/power continuation is feasibility research only; no new source has been enabled beyond the conditional three-card gate.
